examples.text_zh: 这些点心对整个团体来说是件好事。

examples.text_en: The old refrigerant was in a large box.
examples.text_zh: 那种旧制冷剂装在一个大箱子里。

examples.text_en: They did use a refrigerant to keep the food safe.
examples.text_zh: 他们用制冷剂来保存食物。

examples.text_en: They will refrigerate the food for the whole week.
examples.text_zh: 他们会把食物冷藏一整周。

examples.text_en: He did refrigerate the water in the old box.
examples.text_zh: 他把水放在那个旧箱子里冷藏。

examples.text_en: The refrigeration of the food was important for health.
examples.text_zh: 食物的冷藏对健康很重要。

examples.text_en: They did work on the refrigeration of the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 他们致力于整个房间的制冷。

examples.text_en: The refulgent light was clear in the dark room.
examples.text_zh: 那辉煌的光芒在暗室里清晰可见。

examples.text_en: They did see a refulgent form in the far west.
examples.text_zh: 他们在遥远的西方看到一个灿烂的影子。

examples.text_en: The regal old man did stand and talk.
examples.text_zh: 那位气度如帝王般的老人站起来讲了话。

examples.text_en: She was regal in the light of the morning.
examples.text_zh: 在清晨的光线里，她显得雍容华贵。

examples.text_en: They will regale the whole group with a story.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用一个故事款待、取悦整个团体。

examples.text_en: He did regale the young child with a song.
examples.text_zh: 他用一首歌逗那个小孩开心。

examples.text_en: The old town will regenerate after a long time.
examples.text_zh: 这座老镇会在很长时间后重新焕发生机。

examples.text_en: They did regenerate the whole area in a year.
examples.text_zh: 他们在一年内使整个地区重获新生。

examples.text_en: The regeneration of the old town was a big job.
examples.text_zh: 这座老镇的重建是项大工程。

examples.text_en: They did work on the regeneration of the whole area.
examples.text_zh: 他们致力于整个地区的重建。

examples.text_en: The regenerative power of the body was clear.
examples.text_zh: 身体再生的能力显而易见。

examples.text_en: They did study the regenerative part of the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了这整件事中具再生性的那部分。

examples.text_en: The regent did control the whole land.
examples.text_zh: 那位摄政者控制着整片土地。

examples.text_en: He was a regent for the young king.
examples.text_zh: 他是那位年幼国王的摄政者。

examples.text_en: His regimen was hard but good for his health.
examples.text_zh: 他的养生法很辛苦，但对健康有益。

examples.text_en: They did follow a hard regimen every day.
examples.text_zh: 他们每天遵循着严格的生活规律。

examples.text_en: The regiment did move to the far south.
examples.text_zh: 那个团开拔到了遥远的南方。

examples.text_en: They did see a large regiment near the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们在镇子附近看到一支庞大的部队。
